candidate_order: Material, increasing grid, Verlet CFL 0.25, Verlet CFL 0.125, Craig-Bampton m128; three consecutive independent constructions of each candidate.
dimension: Full pressure n^2; Craig-Bampton r=n+256. The time recurrence stores two full pressure arrays.
norm: Equal-weight Frobenius norm over all 641 output times including t=0, four receivers and three sources.
cost: Include assembly, independent basis construction, projection and eigensolve, propagation, receiver output; exclude reference evaluation, diagnostics and file I/O. Report the median of the three complete stage sums.
purpose: Grid-density diagnostic for fixed Craig-Bampton m128 and two fixed Stormer-Verlet CFL values. All 81 settings are remeasured in one batch. The original sparse-grid experiment is retained without modification.
scope: The envelopes compare the prescribed candidates over 5-10% receiver tolerance. They do not optimize reduced capacity, CFL, solver family, source distribution or continuum accuracy.
